limitations.en: Selected commissioning/diagnostic sections reviewed; complete manual, exact pinout and firmware compatibility remain incomplete. Legacy documents do not establish present availability.

description.en: Adjusts incident light level and threshold from target/background samples.
description.pt: Ajusta nível de luz e limiar usando amostras de alvo/fundo.

description.en: Response mode changes speed, light intensity and interference behavior; use the variant table.
description.pt: Modo de resposta altera velocidade, intensidade e interferência; consulte a tabela da variante.

description.en: Through-beam detection uses Dark ON; reflective detection uses Light ON for output active with a workpiece.
description.pt: Detecção por barreira usa Dark ON; reflexiva usa Light ON para saída ativa com alvo.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: UP/DOWN adjusts the threshold; holding changes it faster.
description.pt: UP/DOWN ajusta o limiar; manter pressionado acelera a alteração.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: After tuning, DPC compensates incident-light changes; recommended for through-beam/retroreflective use.
description.pt: Após TEACH, DPC compensa mudanças na luz recebida; recomendado para barreira/retroreflexivo.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: Disables button operation; use the manual key combination for at least 3 seconds to toggle.
description.pt: Desabilita operação das teclas; use combinação do manual por ao menos 3 segundos para alternar.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: Clean fibre sensing surfaces and recover the original received light, then repeat Smart Tuning.
description.pt: Limpe superfícies das fibras e recupere luz recebida original; depois repita Smart Tuning.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: Cycle power; if unresolved, perform the documented settings reset.
description.pt: Reenergize; se persistir, execute reset de ajustes documentado.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: Check output load, wiring and short circuit against the exact-model ratings.
description.pt: Confira carga, ligação e curto-circuito segundo limites do modelo exato.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: Check power/cable if fully blank; check Eco mode when only digital indication is absent.
description.pt: Confira alimentação/cabo se tudo apagado; confira modo Eco se apenas indicação digital ausente.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: Use S.TUNE once with the workpiece present and once absent; tuning selects the midpoint between the two received light levels.
description.pt: Use S.TUNE uma vez com alvo presente e uma vez ausente; TEACH seleciona ponto médio entre os dois níveis de luz.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred

description.en: User Save preserves the current user setting; User Reset reads that saved setting. E3NX user saving/resetting applies to bank-common settings.
description.pt: User Save preserva ajuste atual; User Reset recupera ajuste salvo. No E3NX, gravação/reset do usuário se aplica a ajustes comuns dos bancos.

source.applicability: E3NX-FA11 2M; explicit standard/IO-Link subfamily, no unreviewed wiring inferred
